title: pane.send
description: Types text into a pane's program as it is, through the pane's input queue. Text over 4096 bytes is refused, not cut. A pane takes at most 20 sends a second: one more is refused as rate limited, as is a send when the pane's input queue is full. Needs hello version 2, and the pane must be the caller's own or one it spawned, or one they spawned (the self and children scopes).

pane.description: The pane's number, which must be the caller's own or one it spawned.

text.description: At most 4096 bytes of UTF-8. It runs a command only if it carries the line end the program expects.
